name: codegraph-recorder
description: Thin shell over the codegraph-trace CLI: records human commits into the trace, keeps the graph fresh (reindex + reconcile), keeps the decision ledger up to date, and shows everything in the editor. All intelligence stays in the Python CLI.

commands.title: Codegraph: Roll back to a recorded step (new git branch)
Codegraph: Restore a symbol's recorded version (editor edit)

codegraph.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter of the venv where codegraph-trace is installed.

codegraph.repoRoot.description: Repository root being recorded. Empty = the first workspace folder.

codegraph.graphDbPath.description: Exact path to the codebase-memory-mcp code-graph SQLite DB for this repo. Empty = verified auto-discovery (matches projects.root_path; never picks another project's map).

codegraph.driverAuthor.description: Git author name of the agent driver. Commits by this author are skipped (the driver already records them).

codegraph.cbmCliPath.description: Path to the codebase-memory-mcp binary used for 'cli index_repository' after each human commit.

codegraph.semgrepPath.description: Path to the semgrep binary (pip install semgrep puts it next to the venv python).
